journey.title: OpenBeacon map smoke (throwaway)
journey.description: Throwaway synthetic journey used to compare local Android agent-verification runners against the real OpenBeacon development build. Uses only a disposable email/password account and a mock GPS fix. No personal, family, or real location data is involved.
journey.precondition: The OpenBeacon development build is installed and loaded from the local Metro dev server, showing the unauthenticated landing screen.

steps.step: Confirm the landing screen shows the "Sign In" and "Create Account" actions.
Enter the disposable email into the Email field and the password into the Password field.
Tap the "Sign In" button to authenticate.
If a "Allow background location" prompt appears, tap "Not now".
Confirm the Map tab is active and the MapLibre map surface is visible.
Capture a screenshot of the rendered MapLibre map.
Pan the map with a swipe gesture and capture a second screenshot.
Confirm the app is observing the injected device location (Logcat FusedLocation delivery).

assertions.assertion: The landing screen exposes semantic "Sign In" text.
The MapLibre map surface renders map tiles.
The map responds to a pan gesture.
The device location is delivered to the app after the mock GPS fix.
